most_similar_reason: Candidate 2 shares the core narrative almost point for point: a righteous man forewarned of a divinely sent flood sent to punish human wickedness, who builds a wooden vessel, rides out the deluge with his wife, lands on a mountain when the waters recede, gives thanks/sacrifice to the god, and then becomes the ancestor from whom repopulated peoples and founding lineages descend.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 1 has no flood, no ark, no ancestral line or covenant, and instead concerns a creator god's death and duel with personified Death, sharing only the generic presence of a deity.
